prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Company news: internet, media, gaming and telecom.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Every material company-specific news item for US-listed internet, media, gaming and telecom companies >= $1B in the window, as many as you can find: press releases, 8-K filings, executive changes, activist campaigns, legal settlements, contracts, product launches, guidance, analyst rating/PT changes (firm, old → new), and the stock move. One bullet per company.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## **PTC** [Software & SaaS]
- Schneider Electric agreed to acquire **PTC** in an all-cash transaction valuing PTC’s equity at approximately **$22.6 billion**; PTC shares rose **37% in premarket trading** on Monday, October 5. The Reuters result does not provide the offer price per share or PTC’s prior closing price. [report] (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 07:21 ET)

## **Cerebras Systems** [AI Infrastructure]
- **Cerebras Systems** shares rose **6.6% in premarket trading** after OpenAI CEO **Sam Altman** described Cerebras as a “close partner” and said the companies had “deep engagement” focused on processing speed. [report] (Reuters, Oct. 5, 2026, 07:21 ET)

## **AT&T / T-Mobile US / Verizon Communications** [Wireless & Mobile]
- **AT&T**, **T-Mobile US**, and **Verizon Communications** launched a joint venture aimed at eliminating wireless dead zones; the available report does not state the venture’s name, ownership percentages, launch date, or financial terms. (The Verge, published Oct. 1, 2026; indexed Oct. 5, 2026)

## Paramount Global / Warner Bros. Discovery** [Media]
- A market report stated that **Paramount** would become **“Skydance”** after a megamerger with **Warner Bros.** closes; the available result does not provide confirmation of the transaction’s closing, terms, or the relevant publicly traded ticker. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2, 2026, 21:52 ET)

## Gaming / Sony Group** [Gaming]
- **Sony Group** introduced an updated **PS5 Slim** featuring a revised cooling design; the available report does not provide a launch price, release date, or confirmed impact on Sony’s financial guidance. (Headlines Briefing, Oct. 4, 2026, 04:02 ET)

## NVIDIA** [Internet, Media & Gaming — market move]
- **NVIDIA** reached an intraday high of **$237.88** on Friday, October 2, and its market capitalization exceeded **$5.7 trillion**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2, 2026, 05:54 ET)

## Netflix** [Internet & Platforms — market move]
- **Netflix** reached a new **52-week low of $67.06** on Friday, October 2, which was **0.8% below** its prior July 20 low and approximately half its price one year earlier. (247WallSt, Oct. 2, 2026, 16:00 ET)

## Market / Macro** [Macro]
- The U.S. added **29,000 jobs in September**, below the cited economist estimate of **90,000**, while the unemployment rate rose to **4.2%**; the report was published Friday, October 2. (Yahoo Finance, Oct. 2, 2026, 18:52 ET)
